# InspectionReport fixtures

`dotnetrepoinspector-v1.6.5-canonical.json` is a formatting-only copy of the public canonical example at `docs/en/schema/examples/inspection-v1.example.json` from the DotNetRepoInspector `v1.6.5` tag. Its values and contract shape are unchanged.

`integration-kinds-v1.6.json` is a Repo2C4 interoperability fixture derived from that public schema. It covers the Phase 8 HTTP, messaging, data/storage, unknown-target, and low-confidence cases without source bodies or configuration values.
